title: Goading Roar
html:
Goading Roar is a  Wild Shape: Bear and  Bear Companion action. Bears use this ability to taunt enemies into attacking them.

Description

Roar at nearby enemies to goad them into attacking you.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Details
 WIS Save (Spell save DC)
 AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius

Technical details

UIDs
Shout_GoadingRoar_Bear_Summon
Shout_Roar_Bear_Polar

Condition: Goaded

 Goaded

Duration: 2 turns

 WIS Save (Spell save DC)

  • Must attack the goading creature, if possible.
  •  Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against targets other than the spellcaster.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Ursa, Ursa Ingens, Ursa Major, and Wild Shape: Bear
